stem:
Saanvi studies alveoli in the lungs. Fresh air fills the alveoli. Thin alveolar walls sit next to blood. Oxygen and carbon dioxide move during gas exchange.

Which claim correctly describes that exchange?

options.text: Alveoli transfer oxygen to the blood and receive carbon dioxide from the blood.
Alveoli transfer carbon dioxide to the blood and receive oxygen from the blood.
Alveoli only move oxygen; carbon dioxide never enters or leaves the blood at the alveoli.
Gas exchange at the alveoli is the same process as food digestion in the stomach.

teacher.key_rationale: At the alveoli, oxygen moves into blood and carbon dioxide moves out of blood into the alveolar air.
